items.title: 56711_Buster Smith oral history interview
items.q: Charlie Christian, then they had another boy named Casey who played guitar when Charlie left.

ctx.x: Yeah. Charlie Christian, then they had another boy named Casey who played guitar when Charlie left. Named Casey. He played a lot of guitar, too. But he died. Oh, several of them cats there. Some of them boys I didn't know; all of them were good musicians.
Was it a band that stuck very much in the Nebraska area? Did they tour much?
